item.text:
Infeasible in this GIMP install.

GIMP 2.10.30 only supports RGB, Grayscale, and Indexed image modes. Its color-profile conversion procedure also explicitly accepts only RGB and grayscale ICC profiles, so it cannot convert the open image into true CMYK mode within GIMP. No CMYK/separate plugin is installed either.

A CMYK file could be generated outside GIMP using the installed ICC tools, but not as a GIMP image mode here.
